title: Seagrove Beach "Vacay All Day" 169 Brown Street
h1: Seagrove Beach "Vacay All Day" 169 Brown Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private heated pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1 through May 1 for $35 per day**- Large porches with outdoor living space- Short walk to nearby beach accesses- 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 5 Adult Bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Vacay All Day is the perfect 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath retreat for a much-needed beach vacation! This modern, 2-story home offers a luxurious escape to the Seagrove Beach community—uncrowded beaches with an Old Florida vibe just steps from Santa Rosa Beach. Guests will love the private pool, expansive outdoor space, and modern interior. This spacious home sleeps 16.With its expansive great room, Vacay All Day is a dream come true for large groups or family getaways. On the first floor, natural light floods the bright, airy living room as guests watch TV and unwind on the luxurious linen sofa or 2 plush armchairs. Guests will have direct access to the outdoor deck and patio from the living room, which features a gas grill, private pool, and incredible views. An adjacent 8-seat formal dining table offers plenty of space for entertaining guests as the fully equipped kitchen with granite countertops, top-of-the-line appliances, and a 4-stool breakfast bar/island make it easy to host and cook. The primary bedroom is on this floor, along with a queen sleeper sofa—perfect for additional sleeping arrangements.Climb the grand wooden staircase and explore a heavenly second floor with 3 bedrooms, 1 bunk room, and another living area. Perfect for the kids to kick back on the comfy queen sleeper sofa and watch TV or hang out on one of 3 armchairs to play a card game. Before bed, step outside onto the covered balcony with a ceiling fan and outdoor furniture to enjoy the fresh coastal breeze. This home features 2 sets of washers and dryers, one set on the main floor and a set on the second floor offers convenience during your stay, while plenty of space lets your family relax.Easily explore the surrounding 30A area with on-site parking for 4 vehicles or via the 5 complimentary adult bikes provided with the property. Make Vacay All Day part of your travel itinerary for stunning views of the Forgotten Coast this year. Don’t wait! Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Additional Living Area: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa**Please note that in order to utilize the Low-Speed Vehicle that comes with the home, you will be required to pay a $30 non-refundable deposit to 30a Gulf Carts.
